title.narrative: This year, UNICEF strengthened efforts to reduce harmful practices affecting children's learning and protection through evidence-informed tools and social and behavioural data. The focus was on reducing child marriage, teenage pregnancy, and corporal punishment, while promoting safe school environments. In collaboration with the Ministries of Gender and Education, positive parenting messages were integrated into schools and communities. These efforts promoted non-violent, nurturing behaviours that improved children's readiness and continuity of learning.
